details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:149-170 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` hides fetch failures, so the version-bump loop can run against stale local tag data.
  WHY: Reviewers noted that if the fetch fails, local `git rev-parse` checks can miss remote tags and select an already-used version, deferring the collision to later validation.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:139-170 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The version-scan glob matches prerelease tags like `v1.4.2-beta`, causing patch extraction or arithmetic to fail on non-numeric text.
  WHY: Reviewers observed that `cut -d. -f3` can yield strings such as `2-beta.1`, which breaks the bump loop under `set -euo pipefail`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3639 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The remote tag check treats every non-zero `git ls-remote --exit-code` result as “tag absent.”
  WHY: That conflates “not found” with transport or auth failures, so transient errors can let the workflow proceed as if the tag were missing.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3682-3685 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `_gh_retry ... || echo "pending"` turns repeated API failures into a synthetic pending state that does not block release.
  WHY: Under sustained GitHub API errors, the gate proceeds without verified source-branch CI status, so a release can be cut with unknown CI health.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:70-113 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The conflict path aborts the merge and pushes from `refs/remotes/origin/stable`, so the resulting PR does not preserve the attempted merge context.
  WHY: Reviewers said the fallback is intentional for manual resolution, but it discards the merge result and conflict-hunk information that would otherwise help review.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:175-177 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: If the bump loop exhausts all 1000 attempts, `NEXT` is never assigned before the final guard.
  WHY: The current `${NEXT:-}` check prevents failure today, but reviewers flagged the implicit unset state as fragile for future edits.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3635 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The remote tag check happens in a separate job before the release push, leaving a narrow race where another workflow can create the tag afterward.
  WHY: The reviewer noted this can still make one run succeed and a concurrent run fail, even though it is an inherent multi-job race.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3639 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git ls-remote --exit-code --tags origin "refs/tags/${VERSION}"` treats fatal transport errors the same as a missing tag.
  WHY: A network or auth failure falls through the `if` and the workflow continues as if the tag were absent, creating a misleading delayed failure.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~150 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` suppresses fetch failures, so collision avoidance runs on stale tag data.
  WHY: If the fetch fails, the local tag namespace may miss remote tags and the bump loop can select an already-used version.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~3682-3685 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `_gh_retry gh api ... 2>/dev/null || echo "pending"` turns API exhaustion into a pending state that does not block release.
  WHY: When repeated API errors exhaust retries, the workflow proceeds without verified CI status on the source branch.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~150 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` silently swallows fetch errors.
  WHY: A failed fetch leaves stale local tags, so the workflow may compute a version that already exists remotely and only fail later.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~139-165 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The glob `v[0-9]*.[0-9]*.[0-9]*` can match prerelease tags and break patch arithmetic.
  WHY: If a tag like `v1.4.2-beta` is selected, `cut -d. -f3` yields non-numeric text and `$((PATCH + 1))` fails under `set -euo pipefail`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~3627-3635 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-remote --exit-code` check treats non-zero exits as “tag not found.”
  WHY: Network, auth, or repository errors can fall through the check and let the workflow proceed as if the tag were absent.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:~70-105 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The conflict path aborts the merge and then pushes a branch from `origin/stable`, discarding the attempted merge result.
  WHY: The fallback branch still contains the stable changes, but the actual merge attempt and conflict context are lost.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:167-170 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The prerelease-matching glob can feed non-numeric patch text into arithmetic expansion.
  WHY: A tag like `v1.4.2-beta` makes `PATCH` non-numeric, which aborts the version bump loop under `set -euo pipefail`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:149 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` hides tag-sync failures.
  WHY: If the fetch fails, the collision-avoidance loop operates on an incomplete local tag set and may pick a version already present on origin.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3636-3639 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The remote tag existence check has no retry logic and treats transport errors like a missing tag.
  WHY: Transient DNS, auth, or network failures can return non-zero and let the workflow proceed to tag creation.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:175-177 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: `NEXT` is only assigned inside the loop, so exhausting all 1000 iterations leaves it unset.
  WHY: The current `${NEXT:-}` guard masks the issue today, but the implicit unset state is fragile if the guard changes.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~3682 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `STATE=$(_gh_retry gh api ... 2>/dev/null || echo "pending")` can mask repeated API failures as a benign pending state.
  WHY: If GitHub’s API is unavailable long enough to exhaust retries, the release gate proceeds without confirmed CI status.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3629-3635 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `git ls-remote --exit-code` tag check treats every non-zero exit as “tag missing.”
  WHY: Transport or auth failures fall through the condition and let the workflow continue instead of failing early.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:93-100,107-113 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The conflict path aborts the merge and then pushes from `refs/remotes/origin/stable`, so the PR no longer reflects the attempted merge.
  WHY: The manual-resolution PR is created without the actual merge commit or conflict context, which loses information useful to reviewers.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~153 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` makes remote-tag sync failures invisible.
  WHY: A partial or failed fetch leaves stale local tag data, so the bump loop can choose a version that already exists remotely.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:150-170 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `git fetch --tags --force origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` swallows all fetch errors.
  WHY: If tags cannot be fetched, the collision loop uses stale local tags and can pick a `NEXT` value that already exists remotely.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~139-165 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The tag glob can match prerelease tags and make the patch bump arithmetic fail.
  WHY: A prerelease like `v1.4.2-beta.1` produces non-numeric patch text and aborts the loop under `set -euo pipefail`.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~3615-3680 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The CI status check can fall back to `pending` after `_gh_retry` exhausts retries, even when the API is failing.
  WHY: A persistent 5xx, malformed response, or network failure can bypass the CI gate and let the release proceed unverified.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3639 | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `git ls-remote --exit-code` has no retry wrapper, so transient failures are treated as a missing tag.
  WHY: A network or rate-limit blip can cause the workflow to proceed to a duplicate-tag push instead of failing early.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:76-78 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The merge-conflict path aborts the merge, then falls back to a PR built from `origin/stable`, so the attempted resolution is discarded.
  WHY: The resulting manual PR shows the stable branch state but not the merge commit or conflict resolution attempt that triggered it.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:175-177 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: `NEXT` is only set on the success path of the bump loop, so exhausting the loop leaves it unset.
  WHY: The final guard catches it now, but the implicit unset state is brittle and easy to break in future edits.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:3627-3635 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The remote tag check is separated from tag creation by another job, leaving a TOCTOU window.
  WHY: Another workflow can create the tag after the check but before the push, so one run still succeeds and the other fails.
=== END FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
